expectations.text: Generated DSL validates cleanly with the Structurizr CLI

expectations.text: Does not invent technologies or elements the user never stated

expectations.text: Payments and notifications platform classified by ownership (external software systems) or explicitly questioned — not silently absorbed as containers

expectations.text: Final response asks targeted clarifying questions about the ambiguities (≥2 of: notifications ownership, conciliation job counterpart, Redis role/main store, OrderHub stack)
